title: ReportMeStatsPublish
description: report.me-stats-publish@1: the body of PUT /api/v1/me/stats/published, the person's per-section switch (the owner, 2026-11-09: 'you can make them public if you want, but private by default'). Every switch is named, so a request can never leave one to chance; the route answers the same report.me-stats@1 document, recomputed at that moment.
